name: [HIPPO🦛] FERAL 🐺 Animal Survival
desc:
🐺 Welcome to FERAL. 🦌
A realistic animal survival game!
Be born as a tiny wolf 🐺 or a wobbly deer 🦌, find food and water, and grow from baby to adult in the wild.

🏞️ Explore rivers, forests, a hidden lake and the deep gorge

In THIS valley, every animal is either THE HUNTER, or THE PREY..

⭐ Favorite the game for updates!
👍 Like the game for new animals!
